reviews.title: Great Cooler - Easy to Install
reviews.comment: I have been debating for a long time to move to an AIO liquid cooler, and I researched a lot of them and came across this Kraken Plus 360 RGB that was on sale, so I pulled the trigger. It checked all of the boxes which were RGB fans and a CPU display and of course price. This one is pretty cool, and you have a lot of options with what you can do with the display. I ordered it last night and it was delivered this morning. It took about an hour (maybe a little more) to install start to finish and worked perfectly as advertised. Once I got it installed, I downloaded and installed the software, made some config changes and jumped into a game (COD7). Watching my temps - they never got over 72C which is great as I am usually in the 90s and sometimes hitting the 100C threshold that you want to stay away from. I really expected some issues as far as connectivity and things like that, but I had 0 issues. Very happy with this AIO and I would recommend to anyone that is looking for a liquid cooler. My only advice is to do some research on what you currently have so you make sure you have things like the SATA power plug available and know where to plug in the internal USB connection and the AIO connector on the MB.

reviews.title: Easy install, works great!
reviews.comment: Easy install, works great!  I've got three of these in different PCs I've built.  They keep the CPU Cool.  I like the NZXT display on the computer screen in regular or mini mode so you can just glance over.  Been doing micro ATX builds with 2 fan cards and two fan coolers now.  Works just as good.

reviews.title: AVOID PLEASE

I had to go thru hell and back to make it fit on my nitro 60!!!! That’s that it was installed in the front !! Do NOT get this fan for a compact prebuilt !! My rtx 5070 3 fan is holding the whole radiator !! I am not even willing to take it back out and do all that work backwards to fit in the original fans and cooler .. this is BS!!! The whole screen doesn’t work for gifs nor pictures!!! I need a refund but I am not going to go through the whole headache of uninstalling!!! Omg AVOID !!!!!!!!!! I added photos of the little ash square you can “customize” !!! I wish I can get my money back but I don’t want to go through all the headache of uninstalling and adding the front fans back !!! Dammit $200 and I’m messed for !!!!!!! AVOID !!!
